name: Ciudad Bolívar (Colombia)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and green, the white charged with the municipal arms of Ciudad Bolívar (a tree and hearts, with helm and mantling).
history: Municipal flag of Ciudad Bolívar, a municipality in the department of Antioquia, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Ciudad Bolívar arms — tree and hearts, with helm and mantling
